title: Breaking the 7-Bit BF16 Mantissa Ceiling: O(eps^{2/3}) Residual-Rescaled Spectral Volterra-Newton Refinement for Continuous-Time Generative Flows
description: Reference implementation, raw NVIDIA SM_80/SM_120 PTX kernels, CUDAGraph solvers, reproducible benchmarks, and LaTeX manuscript for Central-Difference Scaled-Perturbation BF16 Spectral Volterra-Newton Iterative Refinement (CSP-BF16-IR) and z=sqrt(tau) high-noise log-SNR diffusion desingularization.
